dek: The Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) has announced the blocking of a Chinese platform that offered educational and employment opportunities to Taiwanese young people. Specifically, the MAC cited that the platform could be used to collect data from Taiwanese young people, as well as that it violated Articles 23, 33, and 3
